heading: Green spaces, without the stress.
intro: [PLACEHOLDER] We supply plants that suit your space and keep them looking their best with regular care visits, so you never have to think about it.
imageAlt: An areca palm in a white pot

offers.title: Supply
offers.body: [PLACEHOLDER] The right plants for your light, layout and budget, potted in pre-loved ceramics where we can.

offers.title: Care visits
offers.body: [PLACEHOLDER] Weekly, fortnightly or monthly: watering, feeding, cleaning leaves, pruning and pest checks.

offers.title: Rescue
offers.body: [PLACEHOLDER] Struggling plants taken to the Houseplant Hospital and swapped out while they recover.

whoHeading: Any space that should feel alive
formIntro: Where you are in Bristol, roughly how many plants, and what you have in mind. We'll get back to you to arrange a visit.
